name: Spirit Halloween
look: A photo of an orange Spirit Halloween costume package in a clear plastic bag with a hanger hook, lying on a blue-gray blanket on a wooden surface. The Spirit logo with a grim reaper sits top left, a large blank white oval fills the right side, and a red corner reads ADULT Size Costume.
use: People invent a Halloween costume for an oddly specific character, habit or type of person and write its name on the package, usually with a matching photo in the white window. The joke is that the store seems to sell a costume for absolutely anything.
slots: the costume's oddly specific name, in big letters on the orange left side
a photo or short caption of the character in the white oval on the right
examples: Guy Who Microwaves Fish In The Office
a man holding a steaming lunch container
Kid Who Asks If This Will Be On The Test
a hand raised high in a classroom
describe: orange halloween costume package with a blank white space
fake costume bag for a weirdly specific type of person
costume pack that says adult size costume one size fits most
orange costume packaging with a grim reaper logo in a plastic bag
halloween store costume template for any random character
origin: Parodies the costume packaging of Spirit Halloween, a seasonal Halloween store chain in the US.
